drafts.alice: Northstar Creative Lab accepts applications from 2026-11-10T09:00:00.000Z through 2026-11-12T17:00:00.000Z, including both endpoints. Applicants must be at least 18 years old. There are two alternative admission routes. Community route: the applicant must be a local resident. Campus route: the applicant must be both a student and a club member. An applicant who meets either route, the age requirement and the application window is admitted. All other applicants are rejected. Guardian consent and scholarships do not affect admission. Attendance is free for every admitted applicant.

repair.en: Northstar Creative Lab admission: An applicant is admitted if and only if all of the following are true: (1) age is at least 18 years; (2) the application was submitted at or after 2026-11-10T09:00:00.000Z AND at or before 2026-11-12T17:00:00.000Z (both endpoints included); (3) (Alternative 1: is a local resident OR Alternative 2: (is a student AND is a club member)). This provides two alternative routes — Community route (resident) or Campus route (student AND member) — where the age requirement and the application window govern every alternative. All other applicants are rejected. Guardian consent and scholarship status do not affect admission. Attendance is free (0 USD) for every admitted applicant with no fee overrides. Fees are charged only after admission, and a fee waiver never implies admission.
repair.es: Admisión a Northstar Creative Lab: Se admite a una persona solicitante si y solo si cumple todo lo siguiente: (1) tiene al menos 18 años; (2) la solicitud fue presentada en o después de 2026-11-10T09:00:00.000Z Y en o antes de 2026-11-12T17:00:00.000Z (ambos extremos incluidos); (3) (Alternativa 1: es residente local O Alternativa 2: (es estudiante Y es miembro del club)). Esto ofrece dos vías alternativas — vía comunitaria (residente) o vía del campus (estudiante Y miembro) — donde el requisito de edad y el plazo de solicitud rigen cada alternativa. Todas las demás solicitudes se rechazan. El consentimiento del tutor y la beca no afectan la admisión. La asistencia es gratuita (0 USD) para toda persona admitida, sin excepciones de tarifa.
